purpose: Reproduce the primary catalogue-scale HDBSCAN configuration from Pena-Asensio and Ferrari (2025) on the full SonotaCo 2025 catalogue without changing the frozen OrbitTrace detector or episode benchmark.

reference.title: Meteoroid Stream Identification with HDBSCAN Unsupervised Clustering Algorithm

independent_transfer: SonotaCo 2023 only after source, package version, and all rules below are frozen

primary_faithful_transfer.reference_label_filter: Remove labeled shower events whose quality-filtered annual shower count is below 100; retain quality-filtered sporadic events.
primary_faithful_transfer.feature_vector: Published unstandardized six-component GEO vector: cos(sol), sin(sol), sin(sun-centered ecliptic longitude)*cos(ecliptic latitude), cos(sun-centered ecliptic longitude)*cos(ecliptic latitude), sin(ecliptic latitude), Vg/72.
primary_faithful_transfer.package_version_note: The paper identifies the open-source hdbscan library but does not state a version; this version is pinned before any SonotaCo catalogue result.
primary_faithful_transfer.minimum_samples_interpretation: Package default; equal to minimum_cluster_size in hdbscan.

secondary_full_catalogue_coverage_audit.classification: predeclared survey-transfer diagnostic, not the paper's reference-label-filtered analysis
secondary_full_catalogue_coverage_audit.data: All quality-filtered labeled and sporadic SonotaCo events, including showers with fewer than 100 labeled members.
secondary_full_catalogue_coverage_audit.algorithm_and_features: Identical to the primary configuration; no parameter changes.
secondary_full_catalogue_coverage_audit.purpose: Measure recovery by frozen reference shower-size strata without tuning toward weak showers.

primary_metrics: normalized mutual information against frozen SonotaCo labels
number of reference showers with F1 above 0.5 and above 0.8
secondary_metrics: full-catalogue recovery by reference size stratum
evaluation.hungarian_objective: Maximize meteor-count overlap between non-noise HDBSCAN clusters and non-sporadic reference shower labels.
evaluation.silhouette_note: The reference paper used 50,000 from a 316,235-event catalogue. This annual SonotaCo transfer predeclares a 10,000-event computational bound; silhouette is secondary and cannot select parameters.

prohibitions: Do not alter the OrbitTrace detector, its gates, or its frozen outcomes.
Do not choose a minimum cluster size from SonotaCo results.
Do not relabel the full-catalogue coverage audit as a faithful reproduction.
Do not access OrbitTrace coordinates, members, scores, or recovery results during this comparison.
Do not claim episode-scale superiority from catalogue-scale HDBSCAN results.
Do not suppress weak or negative HDBSCAN results.
